notes: scripts/shells/win/win_common/TailscaleCommon.ps1:147 Get-TailscaleJsonProperty declares [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Object without [AllowNull()]. PowerShell refuses $null for a mandatory parameter ('Cannot bind argument to parameter Object because it is null'), so the null guard at :153 is unreachable. GlobalVars.ps1:2 sets $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop', which makes the binding error end the script. Two calls pass $null: Get-TailscaleStatusSummary :193 passes $status (null when the daemon is stopped or unreachable, :169-180), and :202 passes $currentTailnet (ipnstate CurrentTailnet is null when NeedsLogin or logged out). As a result, -Action Status prints only an error in those states, the NeedsLogin AuthURL line (:348) never prints, and the Panel skip message (:471) never prints. The owner's live run covered only BackendState=Running. -> add [AllowNull()] to $Object (or make it non-mandatory). Then check both paths by reading or by a scratch call with $null. Do not stop or restart Tailscale. ; TailscaleCommon.ps1:374-385 device parity: the table omits DNSName even though every row computes it (:265), and Linux ts_show_devices prints a 'DNS NAME' column. Linux's parsed table has no Owner and no ExitNodeOption ('offered'); it shows them only through the official `tailscale status` table it prints first. SPW-037 lists different field sets for each side and still says 'aligned'. -> add 'DNSName' to $columns.
